This millet plot is small and I rent it, so I don't want to spend much cash on it. In Tigray the rains have been poor these past years, and millet survives better than other crops without much help, so I save my fertilizer for my bigger plots where I grow teff and other things. I will put some manure from my animals because that costs me nothing, and I will use the seed I kept from last harvest — improved millet seed is hard to find at our cooperative anyway. The plot is only 0.06 hectare so my wife and I can manage the weeding and harvesting ourselves without paying anyone.
